title: Exchange: High Volume Email can send to external recipients
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap, licensing and billing controls are supported. Microsoft documents automated HVE messaging but does not state that nobody approves each message; the billing-policy UI guidance should also name the drop-down on the tab it reaches.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to extend Exchange Online HVE to external recipients.
claims.quote: High Volume Email (HVE) External Sending extends HVE in Exchange Online, which today sends only to recipients inside your organization, so it can also deliver bulk email to external recipients such as customers and partners.

claims.fix: Keep the documented path and append to controls[1].note and the corresponding rendered row note: 'On the Billing policies tab, select a different billing policy from the drop-down menu.' claims.claim: Exchange PowerShell Set-HVEAccountBillingPolicy -Identity <HVE account> -BillingPolicyId <billing policy GUID> assigns the account's billing policy.

Use the Set-HVEAccountBillingPolicy cmdlet to modify the billing policy mapping for a specified High Volume Email (HVE) account. ... Set-HVEAccountBillingPolicy

claims.claim: Support for additional HVE cloud environments is under evaluation.

claims.claim: HVE mail is sent with no person approving each message.
